title: Automatic warning structure for suction cup

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.quote: 一作動柄，該作動柄包含一内桿件一體之一彈簣套 内容置一彈性元件，一套筒套於彈性元件及彈簧套上， 該彈簧套周面之軸向設有導正結構之導引槽、套筒對應 導引槽設有導正結構之凸部，該凸部被導引槽限制只能 軸向運動，該彈簧套上以固定一警報器座，警報器座内 固設電子裝置、感測桿、警報器蓋，該感測桿彎折端恰 容置於檢測器凹槽内，該警報器蓋、警報器座間乃得以 套設一電子裝置護蓋之框體，而該電子裝置護蓋得反折 而蓋於該警報器蓋上固定，該彈簧套一體之内桿件穿出 套筒後乃組設一活塞，該活塞對應感測桿的位置設有階 形孔，感測桿穿出該階形孔時乃得以套設一彈性元件， 再以一扣環扣住感測桿同時限位彈性元件，該内桿件設 有螺紋，一護油圈座，該護油圈座設有螺孔，該護油圈 座組設該護油圈，再以螺孔鎖固至内桿件螺紋，該護油 圈座並設有凹孔供感測桿突伸入； 該作動柄組入該吸盤結構之筒座内，而形成一唧筒 ，得以抽取吸盤與被吸附物間之空氣，使之形成真空吸 力，在唧筒吸盤真空吸力因緩慢回氣造成真空吸力降低 14 M364141 時，其感測桿移動使檢測器作動，警示燈及警報器以聲 光警示，提醒補足真空吸力。
features.note: The reference describes a suction cup with an automatic warning structure that uses a pump to create vacuum and includes electronic devices and an alarm. However, it does not explicitly mention that the device is cordless, handheld, or battery-powered.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: The reference describes a "gasket" (墊片) that is part of the suction cup structure and is assembled at the suction port, which functions as a flexible sealing lip.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: The reference describes a "pump" (唧筒) that draws air to create vacuum. However, it does not specify that this pump is electric or mounted within a rigid body.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference describes a "sensing rod" (感測桿) that moves to activate a "detector" (檢測器) when vacuum suction decreases, indicating a monitoring function.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: 在唧筒吸盤真空吸力因緩慢回氣造成真空吸力降低 14 M364141 時，其感測桿移動使檢測器作動，警示燈及警報器以聲 光警示，提醒補足真空吸力。
features.note: The reference states that when vacuum suction decreases, the sensing rod activates the detector, and a warning light and alarm provide an alert, indicating activation when vacuum falls.
features.refuted: The quote states that the warning indicator is activated when the vacuum force decreases, but it does not specify that this threshold is above the release vacuum level. It only mentions that the vacuum force decreases, triggering the warning.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference describes a warning when vacuum suction decreases but does not specify how the warning threshold is defined relative to load-release vacuum or working vacuum.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference mentions that a warning is given when vacuum decreases, but it does not explicitly state that the warning indicator remains active as long as the vacuum persists below the threshold.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference describes electronic devices and an alarm but does not mention a rechargeable battery or any power source for the vacuum pump.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference mentions an "alarm seat" (警報器座) that contains electronic devices and an alarm cover, implying the alarm is part of the device. However, it does not explicitly state its position for visibility during lifting operation.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a suction cup structure with a handle and various components, suggesting a self-contained unit. However, it does not explicitly state that it is designed for single-hand operation or that it is entirely without external hoses or cords.
